title.narrative: Trade and Transport Facilitation Measures for Strategic Corridors in Africa - South Sudan (Nimule One Stop Border Post)

description.narrative: The Project intends to address both physical and non-physical barriers to trade, that have so far hampered intra-African trade and integration, and increase the efficiency of transport systems on corridors and of their management. Specific attention is also given to small-scale and informal cross-border trade, a substantial proportion of intra-regional trade in Africa, key for income generation, job creation and food security for many poor households and where women are overrepresented. UNOPS' role in this project encompasses both project management and infrastructure implementation.
